title: Downloads folder
whyItMatters: Invoices, tickets, bank statements, installers and photos that were never filed away. It is the folder people forget to empty before selling a computer.
source: Windows known folder Downloads, default path under the user profile: https://support.microsoft.com/windows
notes: Known Folder Move usually does not redirect Downloads, so this folder normally holds the real files. The browser's download history and the files themselves are separate findings.
